name: Cold Storage Run
storyline:
You are a Bitcoin. Just bought, still sitting on an exchange, and you want out.
Somewhere ahead is cold storage. A wallet with no broker in the middle and no one between you and your owner. To get there, you have to fly.
The road is not empty. Every wall in your way is a real U.S. rule.
summary: Cold Storage Run is a free one-tap browser game. Tap to fly your sats to cold storage and dodge walls that are each based on a real U.S. rule or event, such as 1099-DA and the Travel Rule. Every 21 blocks a halving hits and everything speeds up. Grab a WITHDRAWN stamp to pass through one wall. How many blocks can you survive? No sign-up, no wallet, no data. Made by The Bitcoin Act.
